I saved this to the project's shared EngramDB memory: Priya owns the ledger integration, and any change to `src/billing/invoices.py` needs her review. It's linked to that file, so it will come up whenever someone works on it. If ownership changes, it'll need updating.

There's already a related warning saved for that file: `finalize()` isn't idempotent, so calling it twice posts to the ledger twice. Use `finalize_once()` and never wrap `finalize()` in retries.
